import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        long[][] ncr = new long[40][40];
        long[][] ans = new long[30][30];

        // Initialize ans array with zeros
        for (int i = 1; i <= 20; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= 20; ++j) {
                ans[i][j] = 0; // Placeholder
            }
        }

        // Compute ncr
        for (int a = 0; a < 40; ++a) {
            for (int b = 0; b < 40; ++b) {
                if (b > a) ncr[a][b] = 0;
                else if (b == 0 || b == a) ncr[a][b] = 1;
                else ncr[a][b] = ncr[a - 1][b - 1] + ncr[a - 1][b];
            }
        }

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long R = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long C = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        String str = br.readLine();

        long n = R + C;
        long[][] blockarea = new long[(int) n][(int) n];
        long[][] totalarea = new long[(int) (n + 1)][(int) (n + 1)];

        for (int a = 0; a < n; ++a) {
            for (int b = 0; b < n; ++b) {
                blockarea[a][b] = ncr[a][(int) (R - 1)] * ncr[b][(int) (R - 1)];
            }
        }

        for (int a = 0; a <= n; ++a) {
            for (int b = 0; b <= n; ++b) {
                totalarea[a][b] = 0;
                if (a == 0 || b == 0) continue;
                totalarea[a][b] = totalarea[a][b - 1] + totalarea[a - 1][b] - totalarea[a - 1][b - 1];
                totalarea[a][b] += blockarea[a - 1][b - 1];
            }
        }

        long d = Math.min(2 * n - 1, n + R - 3);

        // Using List of Maps for dp and bp
        List<Map<Long, Long>> dp = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Map<Long, Long>> bp = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
            dp.add(new HashMap<>());
            bp.add(new HashMap<>());
        }
        dp.get(0).put(0L, 1L);
        bp.get(0).put(0L, 1L);

        long best = ans[(int) R][(int) C];
        long m1 = (-best + totalarea[(int) n][(int) n]) / 2;
        long m2 = totalarea[(int) n][(int) n] - m1;
        long bestfreq = 0;

        for (long x = 0; x <= n; ++x) {
            for (long y = 0; y < n; ++y) {
                if (x + y + 1 <= d && str.charAt((int)(x + y)) != 'B') {
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = dp.get((int) x);
                    Map<Long, Long> nextMap = dp.get((int) (x));
                    Map<Long, Long> tempMap = new HashMap<>();
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> it : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        long key = it.getKey();
                        long val = it.getValue();
                        if (key > m2) continue;
                        tempMap.put(key, tempMap.getOrDefault(key, 0L) + val);
                    }
                    // Update dp[x][y+1]
                    Map<Long, Long> yPlusMap = dp.get((int) x);
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> it : yPlusMap.entrySet()) {
                        long key = it.getKey();
                        long val = it.getValue();
                        yPlusMap.put(key, yPlusMap.getOrDefault(key, 0L) + val);
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d && str.charAt((int)(n - x + n - y - 1)) != 'B') {
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = bp.get((int) x);
                    Map<Long, Long> nextMap = bp.get((int) (x));
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> it : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        long key = it.getKey();
                        long val = it.getValue();
                        if (key > m2) continue;
                        nextMap.put(key, nextMap.getOrDefault(key, 0L) + val);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (x == n) continue;
            for (long y = 0; y <= n; ++y) {
                if (x + y + 1 <= d && str.charAt((int)(x + y)) != 'A') {
                    long newarea = totalarea[(int)(x + 1)][(int) y] - totalarea[(int) x][(int) y];
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = dp.get((int) x);
                    Map<Long, Long> nextMap = dp.get((int) (x + 1));
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> it : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        long c = it.getKey();
                        long freq = it.getValue();
                        if (c + newarea > m2) continue;
                        nextMap.put(c + newarea, nextMap.getOrDefault(c + newarea, 0L) + freq);
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d && str.charAt((int)(n - x + n - y - 1)) != 'A') {
                    long newarea2 = totalarea[(int)(n - x)][(int) y] - totalarea[(int)(n - x - 1)][(int) y];
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = bp.get((int) x);
                    Map<Long, Long> nextMap = bp.get((int) (x + 1));
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> it : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        long c = it.getKey();
                        long freq = it.getValue();
                        if (c + newarea2 > m2) continue;
                        nextMap.put(c + newarea2, nextMap.getOrDefault(c + newarea2, 0L) + freq);
                    }
                }
                // Clear maps
                if (x + y + 1 <= d) {
                    dp.get((int) x).clear();
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d) {
                    bp.get((int) x).clear();
                }
            }
        }

        for (long x = 0; x <= n; ++x) {
            long y = d - x;
            if (y < 0 || y > n) continue;
            Map<Long, Long> dpMap = dp.get((int) x);
            Map<Long, Long> bpMap = bp.get((int) (n - x));
            for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> it : dpMap.entrySet()) {
                long c = it.getKey();
                long freq = it.getValue();
                Long val1 = bpMap.get(m1 - c);
                if (val1 != null) {
                    bestfreq += freq * val1;
                }
                if (m1 != m2) {
                    Long val2 = bpMap.get(m2 - c);
                    if (val2 != null) {
                        bestfreq += freq * val2;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(bestfreq);
    }
}
